Rune reasoning: DrMundo — Maximum Dosage recovery: Prioritize the Axiom plus Revitalize candidate for ultimate recovery over a small biscuit HP increase. The instant missing-HP-to-max-HP grant, R regeneration and ordinary regeneration must be logged separately: eligible healing amplification cannot be applied to a maximum-HP grant. AP is not a native R healing ratio. Summon Aery: Its separate proc is outside Maximum Dosage recovery; no Aery shield is added to the native R. Axiom Arcanist: Compare eligible ultimate healing amplification; maximum-HP grants and ordinary regeneration are distinct events. Transcendence: Cooldown utility; does not grant another ultimate during this one ten-second benchmark. Gathering Storm: Adaptive stats do not directly increase the HP-based R healing; this legal row is not a fake AP ratio. Conditioning: Defensive utility, not a direct Maximum Dosage healing coefficient. Revitalize: Test native healing eligibility and actual recipient HP on every tick; do not assume regeneration shares all heal modifiers.

Rune preparation: Owner starts at the authored 10% HP with five nearby enemies and exactly 500 earned Heartsteel HP. Record native R recovery for ten seconds and cap effective recovery at missing HP. Test Axiom and Revitalize eligibility on actual R regeneration ticks, with health thresholds evaluated as healing occurs. Do not grant a flat amplifier to every event solely because it came from R.

Rune comparison: Compare Resolve primary with Revitalize and three actually consumed/sold biscuits (+90 HP), with no extra Grasp stacks, if R regeneration does not accept Axiom or the recorded recovery gain is lower. Compare finite Overgrowth (150 observed nearby unit deaths) versus Revitalize in separate legal pages; they share a row. Keep Heartsteel, enemy count and initial owner HP fixed.

Stat shards: Offense haste provides cooldown utility; it does not increase this one native HP-based event. Flex and defense scaling health feed the recorded maximum/missing-health coefficient. Record actual final HP and cap effective recovery at missing HP.
